description: Prompt cache convergence baseline. Values are percentages. Minimum fields are hard regression gates; reference fields are observation lines only. The goal is to keep improving until representative tests converge; the converged value may be higher or lower than any reference line. Round2/helper long workflows prioritize stable cacheable prefixes. Round1/Round3 fast paths prioritize low latency and low token load; cache reuse there is optimized only when it does not make the path noticeably heavier.
